findings.headline: Migrate this lowercase onclick attribute to a camelCase event handler.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 binds an event only for on followed by an uppercase letter; a lowercase onclick on a native element is a plain attribute in the browser, in SSR output, and through spreads, so a function value is stringified into the attribute instead of listening for click as Solid 1.x did.
findings.guidance: Rename onclick to the camelCase handler spelled by Solid's JSX types (for example onClick, onDblClick, onPointerDown) and keep the handler expression unchanged. Keep a string value only if an HTML inline-handler attribute is intended. For a custom event name or native listener options, use a ref callback that calls addEventListener. Stop without proposing a rewrite when a spread attribute or another on-prefixed attribute on this element could bind the same event, or when the intended camelCase spelling is unclear.
